ayahs.text_digital_khatt: قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرࣱ مُّبِينࣱ ۝٢٦
ayahs.translation_sahih: Say, "The knowledge is only with Allāh, and I am only a clear warner."

clauses.translation: Say, “The knowledge is only with Allah,”
and I am only a clear warner.

ayahs.text_digital_khatt: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةࣰ سِيٓـَٔتْ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقِيلَ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم  بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ ۝٢٧
ayahs.translation_sahih: But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call."

clauses.translation: But when they see it close at hand,
the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed,

clauses.text: وَقِيلَ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ
clauses.translation: and it will be said, “This is what you used to call for.”

ayahs.text_digital_khatt: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِيَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِيَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمࣲ ۝٢٨
ayahs.translation_sahih: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Have you considered: whether Allāh should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?"

clauses.translation: if Allah were to destroy me and those with me,

clauses.text: فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ مِنۡ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٖ
clauses.translation: who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?”

ayahs.text_digital_khatt: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَاۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِي ضَلَٰلࣲ مُّبِينࣲ ۝٢٩
ayahs.translation_sahih: Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error."

clauses.translation: Say, “He is the Most Merciful; we believe in Him,
and in Him we have put our trust.”

clauses.text: فَسَتَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ هُوَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ
clauses.translation: So you will soon know who is in clear error.

ayahs.text_digital_khatt: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرࣰا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءࣲ مَّعِينِۭ ۝٣٠
ayahs.translation_sahih: Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water?"

clauses.translation: if your water were to sink into the earth,
who then could bring you flowing water?”
